name: US attached-lid container 27 x 17 x 12.5 in
description:
A US attached-lid container (ALC), also called a distribution tote, 27 x 17 x 12.5 in (686 x 432 x 318 mm), modelled on Akro-Mils 39160 from Akro-Mils sell sheet AKM809. The lid travels with the box and cannot be lost, which is why ALCs are the workhorse of retail distribution, returnable transit packaging and internal transfer in the US.

External dimensions: length 686 mm, width 432 mm, height 318 mm.

No formal standard. The 21.5 x 15.25 in footprint is the common US distribution-container size (Uline Round Trip Totes are 21.8 x 15.2 in, Quantum and Hudson Exchange similar).

GLB (glTF 2.0), real-world scale in metres, origin at the centre of the base. 3,588 triangles, flat PBR base colours, no textures. CC BY 4.0.
